sources: recreation.gov public search API per-site catalog for facility 250035 (catx.py), read 2026-10-22

values.note: $18 a night per site including one vehicle; a second vehicle is $5 a night, collected at the campground. A double-occupancy site is charged per camper.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/murray-bay-campground ('Single Site: $18 per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/250035/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-22 to 2026-09-16: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 18) + notice 'an extra vehicle charge of $5.00/vehicle per night will be collected at the campground', read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: recreation.gov per-site catalog for 250035 (catx.py: all 20 sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Gravel roads and parking spurs. recreation.gov lists max vehicle lengths of 33-60 ft (6 sites at 60).

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/250035 ('Murray Bay Campground has 20 sites', 'Campground roads and parking spurs are gravel') + recreation.gov per-site catalog (catx.py: Max Vehicle Length 33-60), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Drinking water from 2 hand pumps, not for filling RVs ('please come full'); the Forest Service amenity list says potable water is not available, while its own description and recreation.gov say drinking water is provided. Concrete boat ramp inside the campground; on-site host.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/250035 ('Accessible vault toilets and drinking water are provided. The water is 2 hand pumps and are not for filling RV's so please come full', amenities 'Drinking Water (hand pump)', 'Boat Ramp', 'Host') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/murray-bay-campground, read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service 'Seasons of Use: Mid May - September.'

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/murray-bay-campground ('Seasons of Use Mid May - September'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 11 sites reservable on recreation.gov, 9 walk-up (marked W; may already be taken, call the concessionaire for availability). Reserved sites are held until 11 am the day after arrival. recreation.gov: 16 consecutive nights, 32 nights a year, reservations close 4 days before arrival. Run in summer by concessionaire Flathead Valley Campgrounds.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/250035 ('20 sites, 11 which are reservable and 9 that are for our walk up visitors. The stay limit is 16 consecutive days.'; rules maxConsecutiveStay 16, maxStay 32 nights Each Year, reservationCutOff 4; notices) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/flathead/recreation/murray-bay-campground ('managed by a concessionaire, Flathead Valley Campgrounds, during the summer months'), read 2026-10-22

note: Flathead NF (Hungry Horse-Glacier View RD) campground on the east shore of Hungry Horse Reservoir, 22 mi south of Martin City on East Side Reservoir Road; ~31 mi SW of Glacier's West Glacier entrance. Concrete boat ramp in the campground; swimming and cutthroat fishing. --Claude
summary: Concessionaire-run (Flathead Valley Campgrounds) for the Forest Service; 11 sites on recreation.gov, 9 walk-up. Confirmed $18 (2026), 20 sites, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, reservable/some FCFS; changed max_rig_ft 32->60 (rec.gov catalog 33-60 ft); added season (mid May - September), 16-night limit. Not stated: booking window (inherited 180). Note: dropped the '~32 ft' line the catalog contradicts, and restated values.
